children: NIUMA, a Chinese meme project paired with tokenized stock trading, has launched on BNB Chain through Flap and is paired with BABA tokenized assets. According to ChainCatcher, the token has a market capitalization of $2.19 million, 7,091 holding addresses, and 24-hour trading volume of $7.26 million.

The project says it is built around the shared identity of "NIUMA," connecting workers, founders, and on-chain participants through common experiences. It also sets a 1% transaction tax on the stock-token pair, with proceeds used to buy BABA bStock as a holder reward.

title: NIUMA Meme Token Launches on BNB Chain With BABA Tokenized Asset Pair
